title: Venues
description: Venue tiers the player grows through: birtija -> kafana -> restoran -> splav (/data/venues.json).

order.description: Position in the progression, starting at 1. The venue with order 1 is the starting venue.

max_tables.description: Upper bound on tables after table_count upgrades.

arrivals_per_minute.description: Base rate at which new guest groups arrive (before room-mood and upgrade multipliers).

price_multiplier.description: Multiplier on all menu prices at this venue.

offline_income_per_minute.description: Base offline income rate at this venue before upgrade/band multipliers. See economy.offline for the full formula.

offline_cap_hours.description: Base cap on how many hours of offline time are paid out.

guest_mix.description: Spawn weight per guest type id. Types not listed never appear here.
